svg.text: One camera. One scale. Each attachment gets a component that visibly supports it.
THE TORSO GROWS BY ADDING CELLS; SHOULDER ADAPTERS ARE PLACED ONLY WHERE ARMS EXIST.
The three-arm build has three shoulders. Both arm variants keep the same shoulder and hand frames.
one added row / one added socket
Cyan marks = fixed attachment frames. Torso panels have no built-in shoulders. An unused side stays a plain edge.
Review: body proportions, row spacing, shoulder continuity, and silhouette. These are starting templates, not approved anatomy.
